content: These references include works from organizations such as the World Health Organization (WHO), UNICEF, UN Women, and other global institutions. They cover topics such as adolescent health frameworks, gender-responsive social protection, school health programs, mental health interventions, the effects of COVID-19 on youth, and strategies for addressing health inequities. The citations also include technical guidance, policy briefs, and systematic reviews on issues like HIV prevention, nutrition, mental health, and the role of schools in promoting health and well-being. Additionally, the references highlight global initiatives, such as the Sustainable Development Goals, and their implications for youth and adolescent populations.
